nom: Caudalie Resveratrol-Lift Firming Cashmere Cream, Refillable Jar - 50 mL

avis.titre: Skin looks less wrinkled and refreshed
avis.texte: I love this product! I saw it at Sephora and purchased on Amazon. It is pricey but I believe it is worth the money. It plumps up skin, makes wrinkles less prominent, gives the skin a kind of softness and even a glow. I hesitate to attribute all of these qualities to this product. I also recognize that when people give reviews like this one, I tend to think they are exaggerating or even lying. But after having used this product for years. ( and having stopped and started it again) I can honestly say I am positive it makes a difference ( at least for my skin type, which is dry and very sensitive).

Oh I love this brand so much! And this cream is amazing and immediate results! Worth the price! I'm 62 and I live in seasonal area and skin is dehydrated from the Winter cold or drying heat indoors. This brand has never failed me. Fragrance light and disappears. And again immediate results!

I first purchased this lotion while on a trip to Paris, and I fell in love with it! Even though it's a little more expensive here in the states, it's very much worth it. the texture is heavenly and it provides a silky smooth feel to my face. It has a mild scent but I love it. I'd highly recommend the splurge.
This face cream is whipped and smells AMAZING. My favorite night time cream. Everytime I put it on I feel so fancy. Worth the money!

avis.titre: Soft, Hydrating and Firming CreamSoft, Hydrating and Firming Cream
avis.texte: I’m really happy with this product. The texture is very soft and it truly leaves a “cashmere-like” feel on the skin. It provides great hydration and keeps the skin comfortable throughout the day. With regular use, my skin looks more plump and radiant. It’s lightweight and absorbs quickly, which is a big plus. Overall, it’s a great option if you’re looking for both hydration and a firming effect. I would definitely recommend it.

avis.titre: You won’t regret adding this to your face routine
avis.texte: I immediately noticed that improvement in my face elasticity and the softening of fine lines. So much so that I purchased this refill. I use just enough to cover my face and neck and it seems to last me for months. It’s a great clean skin care option since it’s from France and held to a higher standard than US products.

avis.titre: I threw the mostly full jar away.  It's that bad.
avis.texte: I don't get the hype about this cream Very hard to smooth into your skin. It's really greasy. I used it a little off and on at first and then when I used it everyday (2x a day) after 3 days my face broke out in a rash!! That's never happened to me in my life. I threw the whole jar away.
Caudalie e sinonimo di eselenza tutti i prodotti che ho comprato sono buonissime
Lovely cream, been using since Xmas and my skin is so much better, definitely noticed my lines have improved. The scent isn't overpowering either.
I love this product, was given a sample and so I purchased the big version…. but why was it delivered with a mangled box and not even IN the box it was literally in the package next to it??
This cream is good but nothing extraordinary and also the bottle and the actual amount of cream in there is deceiving like wow for the amount of money this is unacceptable some trickster stuff
Reviews say non greasy etc but it’s very greasy / shiny , guess this product isn’t for men

I ordered this refill pod January 25th and just received it February 15th no communication from the company very very small product for the amount of money spent. Hopefully the cream is better than customer service
